editorial_note: Verified-first daily newsroom update. Developing items are explicitly labelled. No headline is included where current reliable reporting was insufficient.

verified.headline: India and US trade talks remain stalled as both sides struggle to bridge differences
verified.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said the long-running India-US trade negotiations have reached a difficult stage, with further give-and-take becoming harder.

verified.headline: India's September fuel consumption rises 3.9% from August
verified.summary: Government data reported by Reuters showed a month-on-month rise in India's fuel consumption in September; windfall taxes on diesel and aviation turbine fuel exports were cut effective October 1.

verified.headline: Titan reports 25% growth in quarterly consumer business sales
verified.summary: Indian jeweller Titan reported 25% growth in consumer business sales in the second quarter.

verified.headline: Smriti Mandhana named India's women's cricket captain after Harmanpreet Kaur steps down
verified.summary: Mandhana takes over the captaincy after Harmanpreet Kaur resigned from the role while confirming she will continue playing.

verified.headline: India beat West Indies by eight wickets in first T20
verified.summary: India took a 1-0 lead in the five-match series after chasing 172 with 32 balls remaining; Shreyas Iyer scored an unbeaten 102.

verified.headline: India among seven countries in preliminary talks to host 2036 Olympics
verified.summary: The IOC said India, Germany, Qatar, Hungary, Turkey, South Africa and South Korea are in preliminary discussions; a shortlist is expected in March 2027.

verified.headline: Magnitude 5.1 earthquake strikes Uttarakhand
verified.summary: EMSC reported a magnitude 5.1 earthquake in Uttarakhand at a depth of about 10 km.

verified.headline: Andhra Pradesh declares drought in 388 mandals across 21 districts
verified.summary: The state government declared 388 mandals drought-affected for the 2026 Kharif season, with 283 classified as severely affected.

verified.headline: Great Indian Bustard rewilding programme marks major milestone in Rajasthan
verified.summary: Two captive-bred Great Indian Bustards were released into Rajasthan's Desert National Park on October 4 as part of Project GIB.

verified.headline: Maharashtra monsoon withdraws early after uneven rainfall
verified.summary: IMD announced an early southwest monsoon withdrawal; 21 districts recorded rainfall deficits although the statewide season remained within the normal category.

verified.headline: Large school protests spread across France amid education grievances
verified.summary: Reuters reported more than 250,000 people took part in demonstrations across France, with disputes focused on staffing, school conditions and funding.

verified.headline: North Korea rejects South Korean accusations over DMZ landmine blast
verified.summary: Pyongyang rejected Seoul's claim that North Korea planted the mine that seriously injured two South Korean soldiers and warned of counteraction.

verified.headline: EU condemns attacks on civilian shipping in Black Sea
verified.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said attacks on civilian shipping in the Black Sea are unacceptable.

verified.headline: UK considers diplomatic response if Israel closes East Jerusalem consulate
verified.summary: Reuters reported that Britain is considering possible expulsion of Israeli diplomats if Israel proceeds with closing the British consulate in East Jerusalem; the report is based on sources and officials did not comment.

verified.headline: US removes B-1 bombers from UK base amid suspected Iran-linked drone plot concerns
verified.summary: Two US officials told Reuters that suspected Iran-linked drone plot concerns prompted the removal; Iran denies involvement and US officials have not publicly confirmed the intelligence details.

verified.headline: US and China reportedly discuss reciprocal visits to nuclear facilities
verified.summary: CNN reported that the countries have discussed reciprocal nuclear-site visits; Reuters said it could not independently verify the report and officials did not immediately comment.

verified.headline: Kremlin warns Lithuania over proposed nuclear-arms policy change
verified.summary: Russia warned that Lithuania's preliminary move to lift its constitutional ban on hosting nuclear weapons could increase regional tensions.

developing.headline: Ukraine conflict: major drone strikes reported around Moscow region
developing.summary: Russian authorities and Russian military bloggers reported a large Ukrainian drone attack and damage around the Moscow region. Individual battlefield and damage claims require continued independent verification.

developing.headline: US-Israel-Iran conflict: leadership and escalation claims remain fluid
developing.summary: US statements about Iran's leadership and military developments are changing rapidly; CoNews should use attribution on all claims and avoid presenting disputed statements as established fact.
